title: Probing the Capsid: pH-Driven Gating at the AAV 5-Fold Pore and Its Role in Peptide Ligand Binding.
authors: Minzoni, Arianna; Bobay, Benjamin; Shastry, Shriarjun; Barbieri, Eduardo; Brino, Brandon; Collazo, Crystal; Kamita, Shizuo; Wang, Danni; Khuu, Ciera; Polgar, Alexander; Siino, Joseph; Koley, Sushmita; Russelburg, Peyton; Snyder, Mark; Belisle, Christopher; Daniele, Michael; Menegatti, Stefano
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟研究AAV8/AAV9衣壳五重孔道的pH依赖性构象门控，并结合实验验证肽配体识别，虽以病毒衣壳为对象，但其构象采样与序列设计框架可迁移至蛋白质结构计算研究。
abstract: Background/Objectives: Adeno-associated virus (AAV) capsids undergo pH-dependent conformational gating at the 5-fold symmetry pore, but how these structural dynamics shape serotype-specific behavior and affinity-ligand recognition remains unclear, particularly for the clinically important serotypes AAV8 and AAV9. This study aimed to establish a pH-resolved structural framework linking 5-fold pore dynamics to peptide-ligand recognition and to translate this framework into sequence-based design principles for affinity capture of gene therapy vectors. Methods: AAV8 and AAV9 5-fold capsid assemblies were subjected to 500 ns molecular dynamics simulations under acidic (pH 5), neutral (pH 7), and basic (pH 9) conditions, with analysis of pore volume, inter-residue contact networks, electrostatic potential, and solvent-accessible surface area. In parallel, affinity chromatography using three mixed-mode peptide ligands (RVVAVYRI, TTFRAHHI, and TYHHHHII) was performed on clarified HEK293 lysates containing AAV8 or AAV9, with capsid yield, host-cell-protein clearance, and transduction activity assessed by ELISA, SEC-HPLC, and flow-cytometry-based transduction assays. Results: AAV8 displayed a heterogeneous, bimodal pore conformational landscape at pH 7, whereas AAV9 exhibited a discrete gate-like transition with maximal pore constriction at physiological pH; both serotypes showed pore-proximal contact remodeling with distinct network topologies. Experimentally, TYHHHHII achieved the highest selectivity for genome-containing capsids at pH 7, with transduction activity enrichment factors of 2.82 (AAV8) and 5.61 (AAV9), while TTFRAHHI provided the broadest operational pH range for bulk capsid recovery. Conclusions: These findings establish a structural framework linking pH-dependent pore dynamics to affinity ligand recognition and suggest practical sequence-design rules for ligand engineering: clustered histidines for neutral-pH selectivity, Arg-containing motifs for broad-pH robustness, and aromatic or hydrophobic residues for reinforcement of capsid binding.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：腺相关病毒（AAV）衣壳在五重对称孔处经历pH依赖性构象门控，但这些结构动力学如何塑造血清型特异性行为和亲和配体识别仍不清楚，尤其是对于临床重要的血清型AAV8和AAV9。本研究旨在建立一个pH分辨的结构框架，将五重孔动力学与肽配体识别联系起来，并将该框架转化为基于序列的设计原则，用于基因治疗载体的亲和捕获。方法：对AAV8和AAV9五重衣壳组装体在酸性（pH 5）、中性（pH 7）和碱性（pH 9）条件下进行500 ns分子动力学模拟，分析孔体积、残基间接触网络、静电势和溶剂可及表面积。同时，使用三种混合模式肽配体（RVVAVYRI、TTFRAHHI和TYHHHHII）对含有AAV8或AAV9的澄清HEK293裂解液进行亲和色谱，通过ELISA、SEC-HPLC和基于流式细胞术的转导实验评估衣壳产量、宿主细胞蛋白清除率和转导活性。结果：AAV8在pH 7时表现出异质性、双峰孔构象景观，而AAV9表现出离散的门控样转变，在生理pH下孔最大收缩；两种血清型均显示孔近端接触重塑，具有不同的网络拓扑结构。实验上，TYHHHHII在pH 7时对含基因组衣壳实现了最高选择性，转导活性富集因子为2.82（AAV8）和5.61（AAV9），而TTFRAHHI为批量衣壳回收提供了最宽的操作pH范围。结论：这些发现建立了一个结构框架，将pH依赖性孔动力学与亲和配体识别联系起来，并提出了配体工程的实际序列设计规则：簇状组氨酸用于中性pH选择性，含精氨酸基序用于宽pH稳健性，芳香族或疏水残基用于增强衣壳结合。
